announce.name: Announce looting in chat
announce.hint: Post a chat message whenever someone takes an object or coins from a loot pile, or splits its coins among the party.

singleClick.name: Open loot with a single click
singleClick.hint: Players open a loot token's inventory by clicking it once. When off, they double-click it instead.

sheet.label: Nimble Loot Sheet
sheet.subtitle: Loot · {count} objects
sheet.unidentified: Unidentified: players see its unidentified name and description
sheet.emptyGM: Drop objects here from the Items directory, a compendium or a character sheet.
sheet.gmHint: Players can loot this once its token is on a scene and not hidden.
sheet.partyCoins: Move all coins to party loot

coins.title: Take coins
coins.prompt: How many coins do you take?

split.title: Split coins
split.hint: Each coin type is divided on its own. Coins that do not divide evenly stay in the loot.

partyQuantity.title: Move to party loot
partyQuantity.prompt: How many {item} go into the party loot?

chat.splitCoins: The coins from {loot} were split between {count} characters. Each received:
chat.partyItem: {character} moved {item} from {loot} into the party loot.
chat.partyCoins: {character} moved the coins from {loot} into the party loot:

gm.splitCoins: Gamemaster split the coins from {loot} between {count} characters. Each received:
gm.partyItem: Gamemaster moved {item} from {loot} into the party loot.
gm.partyCoins: Gamemaster moved the coins from {loot} into the party loot:

errors.noGM: A GM must be online to take loot.
errors.timeout: The GM did not answer in time. Is a GM still online?
errors.failed: Taking the loot failed. The GM's console has the details.
errors.itemGone: That object is no longer in the loot.
errors.badRecipient: Loot can only go to a character.
errors.notYourCharacter: You do not own that character.
errors.noCharacter: You have no character to take the loot.
errors.noCoins: There are no coins to take.
errors.noRecipients: Choose at least one character to share the coins with.
errors.tooFewToSplit: There are too few coins to give everyone at least one.
errors.objectsOnly: Only objects can be put into loot.
errors.partyLootMissing: Nimble Party Loot 2.1 or newer is not active for the GM.
errors.partyLootFailed: Party Loot did not accept that. The GM's console has the details.
